# LDraw-derived STL attribution

The STL mould geometry in this directory is derived from the LDraw Parts Library
and is used by the Lloyd Tournament production asset generator.

Each source LDraw part is licensed under CC BY 4.0 according to its current
official part header. The STL conversion repository also instructs users to
check the source .dat part license; the relevant exact parts are:

- 61183.dat — Minifig Hair Swept Back Tousled — Philippe Hurbain [Philo]
- 15619.dat — Minifig Bandana Ninja — Philippe Hurbain [Philo]
- 3626b.dat — Minifig Head with Blocked Hollow Stud — Tore Eriksson [Tore_Eriksson]
- 973.dat — Minifig Torso — Steve Bliss [sbliss]
- 3815.dat — Minifig Hips — Steve Bliss [sbliss]
- 3816.dat — Minifig Leg Right — Steve Bliss [sbliss]
- 3817.dat — Minifig Leg Left — Steve Bliss [sbliss]
- 3818.dat — Minifig Arm Right — Chris Dee [cwdee]
- 3819.dat — Minifig Arm Left — Chris Dee [cwdee]
- 3820.dat — Minifig Hand — Orion Pobursky [OrionP]

Source library: https://library.ldraw.org/
STL conversion source: https://github.com/ArjhanToteck/LDraw-Library

The mould geometry is modified by scaling, coordinate conversion, assembly and
addition of original clean-room Tournament-Robe surface details.

LDraw is an unofficial community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed
by the LEGO Group. LEGO is a trademark of the LEGO Group.
